sixBar.independentContract: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-thread-index-and-lazy-boot-design.md §C Maintenance/History page; apps/daemon/src/agent-host/README.md indexer/queries contracts; AGENTS durable log/cache rules: choose newest containing range; when none, nearest preceding start; tied starts use content ordinal; unreadable selected cache row is rejected. Cache may be written by another build, and cannot leak another thread.
sixBar.realRegression: Newest ended row incorrectly outranks an older containing row; wrong tied-start ordinal wins; a rejected malformed containing row silently falls back to valid ended history; malformed nearest gap row or foreign thread becomes a page anchor.
sixBar.independentOracle: Literal hand-chosen older/same-start-earlier/same-start-later/latest IDs for seq28/21/24/45 and null after specific persisted corruption. Delete exact copied old ORDER BY query as expected-value generator.
sixBar.stableSeam: Prefer existing ThreadIndex fixture/public turnOfSeq after writing explicit schema-compatible cache rows through a second SQLite connection to its temp index.sqlite. The persisted cache boundary is explicitly a retention exception.
sixBar.refactorResistance: No SQL text/statement count/query-plan assertion. Fixed public page-owner IDs/nulls survive replacing optimized query implementation.
sixBar.uniqueProtection: Existing overlap test has two containing ranges, but not an older still-containing range over several newer ended ones, tied starts with differing end validity, malformed containing vs valid nearest fallback, or malformed nearest gap row. Existing gap test establishes only normal gap behavior; its positive outcome here is needed as a non-vacuous control before corruption.

implementation: Reuse current beforeEach temp index.sqlite, open a second native connection for explicit row insertion; observe existing public index.turnOfSeq, avoiding an extra in-memory schema and createThreadIndexQueries/SCHEMA_STATEMENTS imports.

Use four current-thread rows: older ordinal1 seq2..40; same-start-earlier ordinal2 seq20..25; same-start-later ordinal3 seq20..22; latest ordinal4 seq30..35. Foreign row has seq20..100 ordinal99 so missing inner/outer thread filtering can actually affect the chosen result.
Retain literal cases: seq28→older;21→same-start-later;24→same-start-earlier;45→latest. Existing test owns ordinary pre-first/overlap/gap semantics.

Corrupt older.first_byte=-1, then seq28 must be null even though nearest preceding row is valid same-start-later. This fails incorrect `toIndexedTurn(containing) ?? toIndexedTurn(preceding)` fallback.
Separately corrupt latest.first_byte=-1; seq45 must become null after earlier positive latest control. Ensure db.close in finally.
Delete legacy statement/46-seq loop and unused direct query/schema imports; leave production seek SQL and cache schema unchanged.

manualBenchmarks.kind: Opt-in manual performance profiling utility; not default CI test or independently counted regression coverage.
manualBenchmarks.legitimacy: Upstream measured performance commit b14610c8 explicitly uses real SQLite before/after benchmark and query plans; parent confirms preserve useful unrelated manual profiling work. Header documents command, representative10kturn/500chunks workload, per-chunk commits, cold-load exclusion and optional production-revision control. Not orphaned merely because no package test script calls .bench.ts.
manualBenchmarks.regressionCoverageBoundary: Cursor/range/count/text and literal generated-turn checks only prevent accidentally benchmarking dropped work; they do not replace required test contracts or impose a timing gate. The copied historical SQL is explicitly an existing-implementation performance control, not an independent expected-result oracle; SQL plan/source instrumentation is profiling observation, not a change-detector regression test.
manualBenchmarks.implementation: No edits. Preserve optional cross-revision execution, temporary-file cleanup, native real SQLite workload, medians and query-plan diagnostics.
manualBenchmarks.cost: Default workload seeds10000real unique turn rows,1cold streaming chunk+7×500measured chunks+finalclose, then7×50old-query control and7×50production boundary lookups. All opt-in; no required CI runtime added.
manualBenchmarks.limitations: No execution in read-only phase. Upstream commit timing claims are provenance only, not measurements by this workstream. Historical mode replaces indexer/queries owners while using current schema/dependencies, so compare compatible revisions; do not claim full historical application latency. In-memory SQLite excludes disk append/WAL durability cost and cold initialization by design.
manualBenchmarks.validationAfterMerge: Optional root-controlled TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 node --import tsx src/agent-host/index/history.bench.ts 10000 500 and compatible revision command; no benchmark runs until explicit test slot.
